note: Kept by hand (F-824, guardrail G15). Every capability of capabilities/inventory.json is mapped here, by its id or by a prefix that names one case section (case:<section>.) or one command's options (cli:<command> --); an id rule wins over a prefix. A rule gives either ui (where the Studio reaches it) or an exemption {item, date, reason, unplanned?}: item is the roadmap item expected to give it a UI path, and unplanned marks an item that is only its nearest home (its acceptance does not name the capability). When a surface lands, replace its exemptions with ui entries, then run npm run capabilities -- --report-only to rewrite docs/studio-coverage.md.
